name: Harm de Vries

affiliations.role: Co-lead of BigCode; lead of the LLM Lab at ServiceNow Research

bio: Harm de Vries leads the Large Language Model Lab at ServiceNow Research and co-leads the BigCode project with Hugging Face. BigCode's StarCoder, a 15 billion parameter open code model released in 2023, was a joint ServiceNow Research and Hugging Face effort, and de Vries is a corresponding author on its paper.
known_for: Co-lead of the BigCode open code-LLM project
